meta.description: Watch multiple YouTube videos and Twitch streams at once, on a single screen.

setup.intro: Add YouTube links or Twitch streams, one per line: the empty one at the bottom is always ready for the next. They all start together, muted — you turn the audio on yourself, one at a time. Then you can copy a link to send to anyone: they'll see the same videos.
setup.linkPlaceholder: Paste a YouTube or Twitch link…
setup.noValidLinks: No valid links (YouTube or Twitch). Did you paste the shopping list?

errors.youtubeFileProtocol: Error 153: open the site via http(s), not file://
errors.twitchFileProtocol: Twitch requires http(s): open the site from a server, not file://

donate.cta: Buy me a coffee or a beer
donate.description: The orb just clouded over... I sense a coffee. Or a beer. Visions are never precise on the details, only on the intentions. Thank you, truly: your gesture means a lot, and I'll always be grateful.
donate.note: Opens PayPal in a new tab: payment happens there.
